messages:
alex: Kicking off rollout v3.4.1 to eu-west in the 21:00 change window. Gradual traffic shift, canary to 10% for 10m. @deploy-bot please watch SLOs and alert if p95 or error rate jumps.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollout started for service=text-gen, version=v3.4.1 -> target eu-west, canary=10%, policy=gradual. Logs: https://ci.internal/rollouts/1767771234 :rocket:

mira: seeing p95 go from ~120ms to ~480ms on the SLO dashboard (eu-west, p95 gen latency). Link: https://metrics.redwood/slo/text-gen?window=5m :eyes:

jen: hold the rollout. pin traffic at 0% for v3.4.1 and keep 100% on v3.4.0 until we understand. Mira can you dump canary logs for the timeframe?

alex: on it, pausing manual shift. jen can you pin?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Pausing traffic shift. Current state: canary=10%, paused by alex. Suggested action: rollback to v3.4.0 or pin routing.

mira: quick log snippet shows increased decode contention and occasional 429s from the kv-cache layer. sample: 
```
2026-03-20T21:05:12Z text-gen[kernel] WARN kvcache miss spike=0.34 ret=429
2026-03-20T21:05:14Z text-gen[worker] ERROR rpc timeout 200ms
```

jen: ok let's pin back to v3.4.0 and cancel the canary. Command: 
```
redwoodctl routes set --service text-gen --version v3.4.0 --force
```
I'll open an incident ticket and tag eng-runtime.

alex: ack. jen please add notes in the release thread and mark the rollout as blocked.

sre-bot: [sre-bot] Alert triggered: slo:text-gen:eu-west:p95 > 300ms for 3m. Incident auto-created: INC-4567. Pager notified: eng-oncall.

jen: INC-4567 created and assigned to @mira + eng-runtime. Adding initial hypothesis: kv-cache change in v3.4.1 interaction with recent kernel-level batching optimizations.

mira: capture heap/metrics from the canary hosts: `scp host*/metrics-*.json /tmp/1767771234/` — I grabbed two full dumps and uploaded to the incident. Seeing elevated cache eviction and serialized lock times.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Rolling back text-gen to v3.4.0 across eu-west. Initiating rollback traffic shift: 100% -> v3.4.0.

alex: please monitor SLOs during rollback. If p95 doesn't fall in 10m escalate to postmortem.

mira: p95 trending down, current 160ms, error rate back to baseline. Nice work.

sre-bot: [sre-bot] Alert resolved: slo:text-gen:eu-west:p95 back under threshold. Closing auto-incident INC-4567 (will reopen if new alerts within 30m).

jen: adding follow-ups: (1) revert the kv-cache kernel flag in v3.4.1 branch and run local perf tests, (2) extend canary observation window to 30m for similar perf-sensitive rollouts, (3) update release notes with the post-rollback caveat. I'll assign action items in the ticket.

alex: thanks everyone. We'll hold v3.4.1 until eng-runtime signs off on the kv-cache fix. Meeting to triage at 09:00 UTC tomorrow. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollback complete. Service state: v3.4.0 -> 100% eu-west. All health checks green.
